## Description

Use when writing or auditing talking-head / narrative / "yap" content — reel scripts, video scripts, story-driven posts, any piece where someone talks to camera or tells a story. The hook stops the scroll; storytelling holds the watch after it. Not for pure tactical demos or bare listicles with no through-line.
